definition: A Math Word Problem Repository is an online repository of Math Word Problems, to provide a unified testbed to evaluate different algorithms.
details: A Math Word Problem Repository is an online repository of Math Word Problems, to provide a unified testbed to evaluate different algorithms.

explainer.lead: MAWPS is an online repository of math word problems built as a unified testbed for evaluating different algorithms. It matters because shared problems make algorithm comparisons possible.

tiers.eli5: It is a shared online collection of maths word problems that researchers all use so they can compare how well their programs do.
tiers.practitioner: Researchers evaluate math word problem solvers on the MAWPS collection so results are comparable across algorithms. The pitfall is that a unified testbed only helps if everyone reports against the same problem set.
tiers.paperLevel: A Math Word Problem Repository providing a unified testbed for evaluating different algorithms on math word problems.

explainer.example: A solver for math word problems is run over the MAWPS repository and its accuracy reported alongside other algorithms evaluated on the same collection.
